highlights: There are no Joining fee or renewal fee associated with the usage of this card.
Union Bank of India Usecure Credit Card is an EMV chip card that makes it very secure.
The card is specially designed for customers who do not have any Income proof but hold a fixed deposit account with the bank valued between ₹ 25,000 – ₹ 5,00,000.
The card has a unique reward point scheme and no extra cost is incurred on redemption of these points.
The card offers great benefits on travel, entertainment and dining transactions.
dining_benefits: The card offers great benefits on travel, entertainment and dining transactions.
insurance_cover: Cardholders receive Accidental Death Insurance Cover worth ₹ 5 Lakhs and Air Accidental Death Insurance Cover worth ₹ 8 Lakhs.
